name: cfb-early-favorite-maker
why: Twelve of fifteen sports agents are barren, while two library reports independently reproduce college-football deep-favourite maker results and the later report identifies lower-band and late entries as weaker. Test a restricted KXNCAAFGAME control: passive YES bids at 93-97 cents, explicit expected resolution 12-48 hours away, at most $2 including a conservative full-taker fee reserve per entry, three distinct games and $6 across holdings and working buys. Preserve queue priority while bids remain valid, cancel stale or duplicate commitments, and respect per-market concentration headroom. The timing window does not prove pregame status, and reused development evidence does not establish this candidate's edge. Retain applicable sports-favorites selection history and require sufficient after-cost replay, independent forward fills and settlements, audit and ordinary capital qualification. Reject sparse samples or negative economics rather than forcing turnover.
